def Target : Prop :=
  ∀ (Fm S₀ S : Type) [LogicalConnective Fm] [LogicalNeutral Fm] [Entailment S₀ Fm] [Entailment S Fm]
    (𝓑 : S₀) (𝓢 : S) [Entailment.Cl 𝓑] [Entailment.Cl 𝓢] (K F : Fm → Fm),
    Def1 𝓑 K → 𝓑 ⪯ 𝓢 → Def2 𝓢 K →
    Def5 𝓑 F →
    (∀ φ, 𝓢 ⊢ K (F φ 🡒 φ)) →
    ∃ ψ, 𝓢 ⊢ K ψ ⋏ K (∼F ψ)

translation: Target is the following proposition. For every choice of types Fm, S₀ and S, of logical connectives and truth and falsehood constants on Fm, and of provability relations for S₀ and S on Fm, take any systems 𝓑 : S₀ and 𝓢 : S that each prove all classical propositional tautologies and are closed under modus ponens. For every pair of functions K, F : Fm → Fm, suppose that (1) for every sentence φ, if 𝓑 proves φ then 𝓑 proves K(φ); (2) every sentence provable in 𝓑 is provable in 𝓢; (3) for every pair of sentences φ, χ, 𝓢 proves K(φ 🡒 χ) 🡒 (K(φ) 🡒 K(χ)); (4) there exists a sentence θ for which 𝓑 proves the biconditional θ 🡘 ∼(F(θ)); and (5) for every sentence φ, 𝓢 proves K(F(φ) 🡒 φ), with K applied to the whole implication. Then there exists a sentence ψ for which 𝓢 proves the conjunction K(ψ) ⋏ K(∼(F(ψ))). The same ψ occurs in both conjuncts, but it is not required to equal the witness θ in (4). No consistency hypothesis is imposed on either system, no closure rule as in (1) is assumed for 𝓢, and K and F are not required to coincide.

divergences.description: The base is not required to be EA. Lean assumes base necessitation, inclusion of base theorems in 𝓢, and knowledge closure under modus ponens in 𝓢 directly. These capture the relevant consequences of extending EA without requiring its full first-order arithmetic or its other K axioms, such as factivity and positive introspection. The abstract conditional therefore applies to more systems.

In the source, F(⌜φ⌝) is an instance of one fixed, one-free-variable formula of L_EA. Lean's F φ need not arise from any formula or coding of sentences. Accordingly, Lean assumes a base-provable diagonal biconditional for the chosen F rather than obtaining one from the arithmetic diagonal lemma.

judgement.summary: Within the declared abstraction, the pointwise hypothesis and conclusion match Theorem 3: K scopes over the whole implication in the hypothesis, and the same witness ψ occurs in both known sentences in the conclusion.
